Honey Chilli Potatoes Recipe Guide
Popular Variations
1
Classic Street Style: Deep-fried potatoes tossed in a flavorful sauce made with garlic, red chili
sauce, tomato ketchup, honey, and vinegar.
2
Extra Crispy Version: Potatoes are coated in cornflour and chili sauce before frying, then tossed
in a spicy garlic-chili sauce.
3
Oven-Roasted Version: A healthier alternative where potatoes are roasted at 200°C for 40–50
minutes before being coated in sauce.
Key Steps for Success
1
Prep: Peel and cut potatoes into uniform thick batons. Soak in cold water for 20–30 minutes to
remove excess starch.
2
Coat & Fry: Dry thoroughly, coat with cornflour or maida, and deep fry until golden. Fry twice for
extra crispiness.
3
Prepare Sauce: Sauté garlic, ginger, and red chilies. Add chili sauce, soy sauce, ketchup, and
honey.
4
Toss: Add a cornflour slurry to thicken the sauce, then immediately toss in the fried potatoes.
Recipe Notes & Tips
1

Recipe Notes & Tips
1
Do not overcook after adding honey to maintain crispiness.
2
Serve immediately to avoid sogginess.
3
Adjust spice level by increasing or decreasing chili.
4
Add capsicum and onions for extra flavor and texture.
